beer.beer_description: Amarillo, Simcoe & Nelson Sauvin hops dominate this Pale Ale, bursting with citrus & tropical notes and well-balanced bitterness.

Powerful and precise, Green Beret packs an arsenal of citrus and pine flavours with a skilfully controlled explosion of hoppy goodness. Mac’s Green Beret IPA is named after the assertive punch of the US hops, but like any good soldier it also knows the virtues of discipline and restraint. The result is a well-balanced IPA that has a complex and rewarding flavour profile.
Mac’s Gold is the talisman of the Mac’s family, an all malt lager brewed naturally with hints of citrus and sweet malts.
Hop Rocker is Mac’s very own Pilsener, with a full complement of Taiheke & Nelson Sauvin hops for well-rounded complexity. Bitter, but in a good way.
Named after its rich colour, Sassy Red balances five malts with a generous dose of Motueka hops for a profound ale experience.
Black Mac is a smooth Porter with hints of caramel, liquorice & chocolate. Earnestly made from a combo of 5 different malts, topped with Fuggle hops.
Interstate is Mac’s take on a classic American Pale Ale. Brewed to bring out the punchy citrus and pine notes of the Citra and Mosaic hops.

Light crystal malt, rolled wheat and unfiltered for a hazy appearance. Citra and Mosaic hops in the whirlpool, and dry-hopped with Citra, El Dorado and Amarillo making this a fruity, smooth and sessionable hazy IPA.
Like a rockstar with a day job, this Session Pale Ale keeps its hoppy flavour blaring, but cuts the alcohol content in half. This brew definitely gets its fans cheering.
Now Mac's has turned 35, we're letting it all hang out. Loads of malt, double the hops and nothing to hide behind. Who says you can only wear your birthday suit on your birthday...? Not us.
Crisp apples from the Hawke’s Bay provide both the clouds & the silver lining in this refreshing cider from Mac’s.
Not every lager is as straight laced as it looks. Just like the librarian who's an inked-up roller derby queen, this crisp pilsener packs an unexpected hoppy punch

Photographers love the hour around sunset, and it’s a pretty good time for a Hazy Pale Ale too.  Do your selfie a favour, crack a can of Magic Hour and say cheese or cheers!

Magic Hour is a Hazy Pale Ale – light, cloudy golden appearance.  Pale malts give the beer a light biscuity background to which aromatic hops are added to give a fresh hoppy taste and aroma without any harsh bitterness.  Magic Hour is a session-able beer.
Galaxy & Citra hops added late on a pale malt base really does smash it out of the park.

Keep your barometer handy, a hoppy storm is coming. Chinook, mosaic and Amarillo hops deliver a burst of fruit and solid bitterness that kicks you right in the tentacles. Originally brewed for #GABS2018.

Brewed in collaboration with Wellington Chocolate Factory, this is a blend of malts producing a chocolate-black brew. They added chocolate, cacao nibs and husks, and cocoa. Complex dark chocolate, with a bitter crisp finish.
IPA with Motueka and Moutere hops and passionfruit
Kamahi, Clover and Manuka Honey. Sweet and sparkling.
Amarillo, Simcoe & Nelson Sauvin hops dominate this Pale Ale, bursting with citrus & tropical notes and well-balanced bitterness.
